## About ARSHIEL SAFETY
ARSHIEL SAFETY (ARSHIEL EHS AI SOLUTIONS), founded, owned, created, and developed by Jonathan Thadanki, is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered Environment, Health, Safety (EHS / HSE / SHE), Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, and ESG Sustainability platform built for global industries.

## Core Services (What We Do)
1. Safety Management (BBS, Incident Investigation, 5-Why RCA, CAPA, JSA, HIRA, HAZOP, Safety Committees)
2. Integrated Management Systems (ISO 45001, ISO 14001, ISO 50001, ISO 9001)
3. Workplace & Operational Safety (20-Aspect Digital Permit to Work, LOTO, Contractor Safety, Machine Guarding)
4. Audits, Inspections & Risk Management (5x5 Risk Matrix, Compliance Audits, Inspection Checklists)
5. Environmental Management (Waste, Water, Air Emissions, Aspect-Impact Registers, CPCB/SPCB)
6. Hazardous Materials & Chemical Safety (SDS/MSDS, UN GHS Labeling, Chemical Inventory)
7. Sustainability & ESG (Scope 1, 2 & 3 GHG, ISO 14064, GRI, BRSR, CSRD)
8. Energy Management (ISO 50001 Electricity & Decarbonization Tracking)
9. Occupational Health & Industrial Hygiene (Medical Surveillance, Ergonomics, Noise & Exposure Monitoring)
10. Emergency Preparedness & Response (ERP, Fire Safety, Mock Drills, Business Continuity)
11. Compliance & Certification Support (ISO, OSHA, Factories Act, OSHWC Code, NBC)
12. Legal & Regulatory Support (Configurable Legal Registers & Statutory Trackers)
